snippet.title: End Fish Demo V2 is OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
End Fish Demo V2 is OUT NOW!

The new version is here, with lots of improvements!
17 different fish species instead of 7!
Shiny fish are now available!
Improved background
Better fish optimization for lower CPU usage
Radio now automatically plays the next song
3 new upgrade modules
Overall game balancing

Play the free demo:
https://ohptie.itch.io/end-fish

#indiedev #indiegame #gamedev #incremental #fishinggame
